_doc: SecurityInsight Pro -- MANDATORY CONTROLS on top of templates. The parts of shipped template items that SecurityInsight's own code requires: a customer override can never switch them off or weaken them. The web app refuses such an override (MandatoryControls, pro-management) and Set-SIProItem refuses it; the run applies the required value on top of whatever is stored (Merge-SIProItems, engine\pro-settings\SI-TemplateMandatory.ps1). Rules: present (the item cannot be switched off), equals, atLeast, above (with Default -- what the run applies), contains. A control exists ONLY because code in this release depends on it -- 'Code' names that code. This is a code contract, not policy: add an entry together with the code that needs it, remove it together with that code.
